translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Jesus me Weni Mmwaen Pilate
Rhooa towunap we ra maegin iutae ra paeninoa Jesus weni mmwaen Pilate,

iwe a rhaepetae aar oaturu Jesus me ee: “Aemaem aeiweri mwaaen een pwe e oatupwuur aeremas, egaen iura pwe resoapw fang tax ngaeni Soamwoonin Rome, nge epwan iura pwe iiy miniwe Kristus, iwe erhai king.”
Pilate a aeiineow pwe, “Een minne aar king re Jews?” Jesus a paniuwaeni, “Een minimwu wo aepesa.”
Pilate a aengaeniir soamwoonin patere kkewe me aeremas kkewe pwe, “Esooar meeta minne i giuneei pwe teren mwaaen een.”
Nge ra egius mwo nge re aengimaaw tae, “Reen aan fenai minne a rhaepiy tae fiiow nepeteer aeremas me wooan oanongaen Judea. Erhaepetae me Galilee iwe nge igina a toorito igeei.”
Jesus Weni Mmwaen Erotes
Igiwe Pilate a rongorong minneei, nge a aeiyeg pwe, “re Galilee mwaaen een?”
Igiwe a pwae ngaeni pwe Jesus e itto me pwiuneoi we Erotes e nemaeni, iwe a fangenoa Jesus reen Erotes, iwe iiy epwan no Jerusalem reen oatowe.
Erotes a igin kker igiwe a weri Jesus, pwe igiwe a fasiun rongorong kkepesaen Jesus nge e tipaeni pwe epwe weri rhag me mweoiuwe. E tipaeni pwe epwe weri aaen Jesus feeori aekkaew kkeman.
Iwe Erotes a aeiyegiy Jesus aekkaew kkepas aeiyeg, nge Jesus ese paniuwaeni.
Soamwoonin patere kkewe me sinsein anniug kkewe ra toonong nge ra aetemaeginiy pwe repwe oamonofitiy Jesus.
Erotes me sonotaw kkewe naiun ra aeni aegekkaei Jesus iwe nge refeeori ngaeni aekkaew min aenneew; iwe ra iseni tae eew mengaag nning wooan iwe nge ra fang sefaaen noa reen Pilate.
Noan raaenin we rhag nge Erotes me Pilate ra maereyaer noa; nge igiwe mmwan nge re aenneew fengaen.
Ra Aettiweginiy Aaen Jesus Mae Noa
Pilate a faingi fengaenniir soamwoonin patere, me mwaaen kkewe me rhooa towunap we,
nge a aengaeniir pwe, “Oaw pwigito mwaaen een reei nge oaw iura pwe e oatupwuur aeremas. Igina iya pipiiy gacchiuw me igeei nge esooar minne iweri pwe oawpwe oamonofitiy wooan.
Erotes mwo nge esooar minne e oamonofitiy ngaeni, iwe a aesefaaenito reerh. Esooar meeta ne mwaaen een efeeori nge epwe mae reen.
Iwe ipwene aengaeniir pwe repwene wirhiy nge ra saeneti noa.” [
Noan oanongaen gupwunon Passover nge Pilate egaen saeneti noa erhai rhooan kanepwus ngaeniir aeremas.]
Rhooanap we ra aekkepwas rhag pwe, “Niiy noa! Saeneti ngaenigemaem Barabbas!” (
Barabbas e kanepwus reen aan aeffiiowuur aeremas noan aepinoamw we me aan nni menaw aeremas.)
Pilate e mwerhaen epwe saeneti noa Jesus iwe a pwan tingoar sefaaen ngaeniir pwuwa we.
Nge iir ra faer aekkepwas sefaaen pwe, “Kurusuw noa! Kurusuw noa!”
Aeinuwaen aaen Pilate kkepas ngaeniir a iura pwe, “Meeta monofit na efeeori? Ngaang esooar minne iweri pwe efeeori ne sipwe niiy noa reen! Ipwene aengaeniir pwe repwe wirhiy nge ra saeneti noa.”
Nge iir egius mwo nge re aekkepwas temoag tae pwe repwe kurusuw noa Jesus, enoa oarosan noa nge ina miniwe ra feeori.
Iwe Pilate a feeori ngaeni Jesus meeta we aar aeremas tingoar.
Pilate a saeneti noa mwaaen we re tipaeni, iwe re kanepwusa pwe e aeffiiow aeremas me nni menaw aeremas, nge Jesus a iseni ngaeniir pwe repwe feeori ngaeni minna re tipaeni.
Ra Kurusuw Noa Jesus

Sonotaw kkewe ra paeninoa Jesus, igiwe ra feffaaeraeg noa, ra rhuungi erhai re Cyrene itan Simon iwe e itto saengi eew soapw. Ra torofi iwe ra ngaettae kurus we wooan, nge ra feeori pwe epwe aiufera kurus we me mwirin Jesus.
Eew pwuwaen aeremas towunap ra tettapwei noa mwirin; aekkaerhai rhooapwut reno neeiir ra saengiti.
Jesus a wegitaeg ngaeniir nge a aengaeniir pwe, “Rhooapwuton Jerusalem! Oawsoapw saengitiaei, pwe oawfaer saengiti gaemi me aetekkomwu naimi.
A ikkitto raaennekena aeremas repwene iura pwe, ‘Ra wenepwu rhooapwut kkena esooar naiiur, esaaen yor mwo aar nainai, nge esaaen yor mwo aar atiut!’
Ina oatona aeremas repwene aengaeni rhug pwe, ‘Piungtiw woamaem!’ nge re aengaeni taeiit pwe, ‘Oapaegemaem!’
Pwe ngaere minikkeei a wenewen iga e rhiuwen arawaraw waniwan, nge epwe ifa wusun igine a ppwass?”
Riiurhai mwaaen, rhooan kanepwus, ra pwan paeniir wow repwe noa niir noa me reen Jesus.
Renoa itto reen pwiuneoi we regaen iura pwe “Peopeoi Rhimw”, ra itto kurusuw noa Jesus me ee, fengaen me rhooan kanepwus kkewe riiurhai, erhai me peig mwaaenin nge erhai me peig rhooapwuton.
Jesus a iura pwe, “Semaei, oamwusaar noa! Rese metaf reen minikka refeeori.” Re aekkaerh dice pwe repwe inetiy minikkewe mengaagiun wooar.
Aeremas ra iun oawruru soamwooniir Jews kkewe ra gaen aeni fetaeneei aegekkaei: “A aemenewaar aaemweoi; iwe nigiti ngaeni epwe aemenewa oanongan ngaere ennetaen pwe iiy Kristus we Deus e fini!”
Sonotaw kkewe ra pwan aeni fetaeneei aegekkaei: ra itto reen ra ngaenneei wine kkewe emwaenn,
nge ra iura pwe, “Aemenewa oanongoamw ngaere ennetaen pwe een soamwooniir Jews!”
Wooan tae rhimwen nge effoat pwe: “Ieen minne Kingaen Jews.”
Erhai me neeiir rhooan kanepwus kkewe e kurus a gaen aessaewa pwe: “Saapw een miniwe Kristus? Aemenewoag nge wa pwan aemenewaegemaem!”
Nge mwaaen we erhai a soong ngaeni a iura pwe, “Wose mesagiu Deus? Oamw mae epwan aeffitaeg ngaeni rhag aan.
Iwe nge giirh ina efin pwe sipwe kurus pwe paniuwaen aenneew kena giirh sifeeori; nge iiy esooar min aenneew ne efeeori.”
Iwe nge a aengaeni Jesus pwe, “Maengiaei, Jesus, igine wopwene noa itto noan nemenem na oamw!”
Jesus a aengaeni pwe, “Iya ppwoneei ngaeniug raaeneei pwe een wopwe no reei noan Paradise.”
Maenoan Jesus
Saengi nugunupaen oanowas nge aenet esa ttin no nge a rorhappiung noa faniuw we enoa gona enuuw konook; iwe nge mengaag we e tteoraeg noan Temple we mwo nge a taeringatiw faaen ruwowu.
Jesus a aekkepwas noa nge a iura pwe, “Semaei! Iya iseni nong minne ngeoniuy noan poawumw!” E iura rhag minneei nge a nurh noa aan ngasangas.
Soamwoonin sonotaw we eweri miniwe a wen, iwe a aepingepinga Deus, nge iwe a iura pwe, “Ennet pwe erhai aeremas mwamwaai mwaaen we!”
Igiwe aeremas kkewe re maegeto pwe rhooan oawruru miniwe a wen, igiwe ra weri, ra sefaaen noa nee iimw, nge ra tugutuguw aiungeer reen aenneewaen tipeer.
Oanongeer rhooa kkewe re giuneei Jesus, fengaen me rhooapwut kkewe re tapweeito me Galilee, renoa iun oawruruto me itaaw.
Paeyinoan Jesus

Eno erhai mwaaen itan Joseph iwe re Arimathea, eew aepinoamw me noan Judea. Iiy erhai mwaaen mwamwaai nge essoar, e wewweti rhag itton minna Mweoiun Deus. Inamwo igiwe iiy erhai rhooan Council we, nge ese tipieew ngaeni niunniuwaen we aar me miniwe ra feeori.
A noa reen Pilate nge a noa tingoar miniwe oanongaen Jesus.
A noa pwinititiw miniwe oanongaen nge a tiugiumi noa noan mengaag pwerh we, nge a oawnanong noan paeyi we iwe ekken wow neeiin faai, iwe esaaen yor mwo manimae ne etonong noan.
Wooan Aenimowu miniwe, a gin egius rhag nge epwene itto Sabbath.
Rhooapwut kkewe re tapweei mwirin Jesus me Galilee ra tapweei noa Joseph ra noa weri paeyi we me wunuunun aaen miniwe oanongaen Jesus won noan.
Ra sefaaen noa nee iimw ra noa oamoannatae aar waningas me neoningas pwe repwe noa aepiti miniwe oanongaen Jesus. Wooan Sabbath ra aseoseo, pwe ina miniwe e foatofoat noan Anniug we.
